name: MaglaSync Free
description: MaglaSync Free helps people continue the same project across ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini without re-explaining everything. It keeps a compact local project state — goals, key decisions, constraints, results, blockers and next steps — and lets the user review it before continuing in a fresh AI chat.
features:
Continue projects across ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini
Compact local project state instead of copying full transcripts
Review and edit every handoff before it is placed into a chat
No MaglaSync account, AI API key, cloud backend or analytics
useCases: Use MaglaSync when a long AI chat becomes unwieldy, when you want a fresh conversation, or when another model is better for the next step. Writers, researchers, students, consultants, small-business users and other everyday AI users can carry the current project state into a fresh chat without reconstructing the brief from scratch.
